blocks.text: PARIS, France — French police arrested or detained about 15,000 people during cost-of-living and high school student protests in recent weeks, Justice Minister Gerald Darmanin told parliament on Tuesday. Darmanin said 7,184 people had been detained during protests over inflation and wages since Oct. 17, some of which escalated into major riots. Another 8,000 were detained during protests by high school students over school conditions.
